out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Soap was not observed at the hand sink in the kitchen and in both bathrooms
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC PLACED SOAP AT ALL THREE HAND SINKS. HAND SOAP MUST BE AT ALL HAND SINKS TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the 2026 permit to operate in a conspicuous location. THE FACILITY CAN ONLY PROVIDE THE 2025 PERMIT WHICH WAS POSTED.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. HANG THE 2026 HEALTH PERMIT BY MARCH 1, 2026.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM AT THE BEGINNING OF THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. YOU MUST HAVE ANOTHER PERSON TAKE THE CFM COURSE AND BE CERTIFIED BY MARCH 1, 2026. SEE WEBSITE FOR APPROVED COURSES: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/health/food/certified-food-manager PLEASE NOTE: A CFM MUST BE IN THE FACILITY AT ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. Napoli T Lounge (Inspection Date: 02/19/2026) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY AVAILABLE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH THE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY PDF. THEY MUST BE PRINTED OUT FOR EACH EMPLOYEE, AND EACH EMPLOYEE MUST SIGN ONE.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH LINK TO PRINT OUT CLEAN-UP FORM. THIS MUST BE PRINTED AND KEPT ON SITE AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SOAP IN THE KITCHEN AND IN THE MENS BATHROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: SOAP PROVIDED TO SINKS DURING INSPECTION

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDSINK IN KITCHEN TO BE COVERED IN COOKING EQUIPMENT AND TUPPERWARE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO SINK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: OBSERVED NO DISCLOSURE STATEMENT AT THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. YOU MUST ADD A DISCLOSURE STATEMENT TO THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU BEFORE THE REMINDER STATEMENT. AN EXAMPLE OF A DISCLOSURE STATEMENT IS: “*MAY CONTAIN RAW OR UNDERCOOKED INGREDIENTS.” THIS MUST BE COMPLETED BY MARCH 1, 2026. PLEASE SEE OUR WEBSITE FOR FURTHER DETAILS REGARDING CONSUMER ADVISORY. https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/health/food/operators/consumer- advisory

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. OBSERVED ORANGE PESTICIDE SMEARED UNDER SHELVING, ON THE WALLS, AND ABOVE COOKING EQUIPMENT AND FOOD CONTACT SURFACES IN THE KITCHEN. PESTICIDE WAS APPLIED BY AN UNKNOWN INDIVIDUAL WHO CANNOT PROVIDE A LICENSE OR COMPANY. THE SUBSTANCE IS CURRENTLY BEING TESTED BY VDACS AFTER SAMPLES WERE TAKEN IN DECEMBER.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. CDI: EMPLOYEE BEGAN REMOVING PESTICIDE DURING INSPECTION. ALL OF IT MUST BE REMOVED AND THE SURFACES CLEANED AND SANITIZED. DO NOT LET UNLICENSED INDIVIDUALS PROVIDE PEST CONTROL. YOU MUST HAVE A LICENSED PROFESSIONAL SERVICE FACILITY ONLY. Napoli T Lounge (Inspection Date: 02/19/2026) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device is not accurate in degrees F. OBSERVED FOOD THERMOMETER READING 28F UNDER 32F CONDITIONS WHEN COMPARED TO EHS’S THERMOMETER DURING ICE WATER CALIBRATION.
violations.corrective_action: Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/- 2 degrees F in the intended range of use. PURCHASE A FOOD THERMOMETER BY MARCH 1, 2026. A DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER IS RECOMMENDED AS IT IS EASIER TO READ.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED ALCOHOL STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE HOT WATER HEATER ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ALCOHOL MUST BE PUT ON SHELVING 6 INCHES ABOVE THE FLOOR BY MARCH 1, 2026.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED THE ICE MACHINE TO BE CONNECTED TO THE WATER LINE WITH NO BACKFLOW PREVENTION.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: PIC UNDERSTANDS A LICENSED PLUMBER MUST INSTALL A BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE LINE SUPPLYING THE ICE MACHINE AT THE BAR AND IS CALLING PLUMBER IN THE MORNING DURING BUSINESS HOURS. DEVICE MUST HAVE AN “ASSE” NUMBER. THIS MUST BE DONE WITHIN THREE BUSINESS DAYS AND COMPLETED BY TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 24TH, 2026.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: A direct connection exists between the drain line of the sanitizing basin of the 3-compartment sink AT THE BAR and the sewer line.
violations.corrective_action: A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed. CDI: PIC UNDERSTANDS A LICENSED PLUMBER MUST MAKE AN AIR GAP FOR THE SANITIZING VAT (3RD VAT) OF THE THREE-VAT SINK AT THE BAR. PIC TO CALL PLUMBER IN THE MORNING. THERE MAY NOT BE A DIRECT CONNECTION TO SEWAGE LINE. PLEASE SEE PICTURES PROVIDED IN EMAIL. THIS MUST BE DONE WITHIN THREE BUSINESS DAYS AND COMPLETED BY TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 24TH, 2026.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the WOMENS RESTROOM.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins BY MARCH 1, 2026.

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: THE MENS BATHROOM door is not provided with a self-closing door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door BY MARCH 1, 2026.
